description: Base contract safety signals from bounded public-chain reads and OFAC. Basic: deployed bytecode and SDN match. Deep adds standard owner(), paused(), totalSupply(), decimals() and ERC-1967 storage observations. Honeypot/sellability, liquidity locks, holder concentration, age, verified source and scam lists are NOT assessed. Missing data is unknown; never a safe-to-buy verdict. Informational, not financial advice. Basic $0.02; deep $0.05. Shared trial first.
name: check_token
title: Base token / contract safety signals
